Productivity means intentional progress, not busyness

Productivity should only be defined by how far the desired activity got accomplished. It’s tied to an intentional goal, or the intentional process of completing something — it doesn’t mean busy.

As long as I’m acting intentionally toward my goals, that’s productive. Whatever pulls me away from what I want to accomplish is distraction. Written while reading Psycho-Cybernetics: pick something to aim the goal-seeking mechanism at — finishing work, the gym, reading, being present with people.
